subject: Packly vendor onboarding — temporary invoice-only path request
messages:
From: Emma Sullivan <emma@packly.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@packly.io
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Packly vendor onboarding — request to use invoice-only for trial (no PO)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to pilot Redwood for our distributed firmware update workflow. Our procurement team is starting vendor intake and asked whether we can be onboarded on an invoice-only (no-PO) basis for the 90-day pilot.

Context: pilot spend will be variable and small initially (~$500–$2,000/month). Packly has standard vendor paperwork ready (W-9, COI, bank details) and a short SOW. We prefer to avoid issuing a PO for each monthly invoice while we validate technical fit.

Can Redwood provide a temporary path (90-day invoice-only) and list the conditions you need (insurance, payment terms, contact info)? Happy to attach the forms — see attached onboarding form and insurance certificate.

Thanks,
Emma Sullivan
Head of Operations
Packly Inc.
attachments: packly_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, packly_insurance_certificate.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Packly vendor onboarding — request to use invoice-only for trial (no PO)

Hi Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround and for sending the paperwork. I've looped in Procurement (Karthik) and Finance Ops (Laura) to confirm our allowable temporary paths and required evidence.

High-level: we do offer a short-term invoice-only exception for low-dollar proof-of-concepts, provided the vendor completes onboarding (W-9, COI), agrees to net-30 terms, and we have an internal spend cap and owner assigned.

Karthik/Laura — can you confirm the threshold and whether SOW acceptance + the documents attached are sufficient to stand up Packly on an invoice path for 90 days? Also copying Jonas in case legal needs to review the SOW.

Next steps for Packly (if approved): sign the SOW (DocuSign link), finance will provision vendor profile, and we’ll route invoices to accounts-payable@redwood.ai with code PACKLY-PILOT.

—Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Packly — recommend temporary invoice-only approval (pilot)

Team — summarizing Packly’s ask and my recommendation:

- Request: 90-day invoice-only onboarding for a pilot expected to be <$2k/month.
- Docs provided: onboarding form (W-9), COI (insurance), basic SOW draft attached.
- Business rationale: quick enablement to prove value; customer is strategic in manufacturing edge and could scale to a paid contract.
- Risk controls I propose:
  - Approve invoice-only for 90 days only.
  - Spend cap: $5k cumulative across 90 days (safeguard).
  - Net-30 payment terms; invoices routed to AP with project code.
  - Procurement to validate COI and banking; Finance Ops to run vendor remediation checks.

Please confirm if the above is acceptable or if we need an alternate sign-off (legal/credit). If you approve, I’ll send the conditional approval to Packly with the DocuSign SOW and the payment routing instructions.

-Marissa
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 11:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Packly — recommend temporary invoice-only approval (pilot)

Marissa — thanks for the summary. Procurement is comfortable with a temporary invoice-only exception under the controls you listed, subject to the following validations (we need evidence before activation):

1) Completed vendor onboarding form with legal business name and tax ID (we have the W-9 attached — good).
2) Certificate of Insurance that meets our minimum coverage (Packly’s COI shows General Liability limits; request COI to include Redwood Inference as certificate holder).
3) Bank/ACH details validated and there are no outstanding sanctions/PEP flags (Procurement to run).
4) Spend cap set to $5,000 for the 90-day window; Procurement to enforce via routing rules in vendor portal.

If those checks clear, Procurement approves the temporary invoice-only status for 90 days. Please note: any single invoice > $2,500 will require an escalation to Finance Lead (Laura) for sign-off.

I’ll run the vendor screening now and update this thread by EOD.

—Karthik
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW-draft-Packly-Redwood.docx (for reference)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Emma Sullivan <emma@packly.io>, procurement@packly.io
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Packly — conditional approval for 90-day invoice-only pilot (next steps)

Emma — thanks for the paperwork and for your patience. Procurement has completed the initial checks and we can proceed with a conditional invoice-only onboarding under these terms: 

1) Duration: 90 days from activation date (starts when the SOW is signed).
2) Spend controls: $5,000 cumulative cap across the 90 days; any single invoice > $2,500 requires Finance Lead approval.
3) Payment terms: Net 30. Invoices must reference project code PACKLY-PILOT and be sent to accounts-payable@redwood.ai.
4) Required docs on file: W-9, COI naming Redwood Inference as certificate holder, and bank/ACH validation completed.

Please sign the SOW via this DocuSign link so we can activate the vendor profile: https://www.docusign.com/packly-temp-invoice-path. Once signed, AP will provision invoicing instructions and Procurement will flip the vendor status to invoice-only for the pilot.

We’ll treat this as a temporary enablement so both teams can evaluate operational fit — if Packly scales beyond this pilot we’ll transition to standard PO-backed procurement.

Let me know if you have any questions. Looking forward to a smooth pilot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
